provenance: Router-derived 2026-07-27 (Cudy WBR3000UAX v1, OpenWrt 25.12.5, zapret2 @ /opt/zapret2). Evidence: live nfqws2 argv of the running daemon (--hostlist=/opt/zapret2/ipset/zapret-hosts-user.txt and --hostlist-exclude=/opt/zapret2/ipset/zapret-hosts-user-exclude.txt, repeated per profile with identical paths); /opt/zapret2/common/list.sh find_hostlists() + filter_apply_hostlist_target() (HOSTLIST_USER / HOSTLIST_EXCLUDE / HOSTLIST_AUTO semantics; HOSTLIST_AUTO engaged only when MODE_FILTER=autohostlist, current MODE_FILTER=hostlist); /opt/zapret2/ipset/def.sh list ownership (ZUSERLIST/ZUSERLIST_EXCLUDE user sources; getuser() regenerates zapret-ip-user.txt from the domain include list; getexclude() regenerates zapret-ip-exclude.txt from the domain exclude list; _get_ipban() regenerates zapret-ip-user-ipban.txt from the hostname list zapret-hosts-user-ipban.txt); /opt/zapret2/uci-def-cfg.sh user-file provisioning; /opt/zapret2/ipset/create_ipset.sh consumers; zapret-ip-user-exclude.txt has NO consumer in any upstream script; nft table inet zapret2 set-reference counts on the active ruleset (@zapret 0, @ipban 0, @nozapret 1); no cron entries regenerate lists; all candidate files are regular files (no symlinks), root:root 0644.

ipInclude.reason: Not user-owned: ipset/def.sh getuser() regenerates zapret-ip-user.txt by DNS-resolving the domain include list over it, and the nft set it feeds (@zapret) is not referenced by any active rule in hostlist mode. Writes would be inert and lost on the next manual list update.

ipExclude.reason: No user-maintained IP-exclude entity exists on this engine: zapret-ip-user-exclude.txt has no consumer in any upstream script, and the engine IP exclusion (zapret-ip-exclude.txt feeding @nozapret) is generated by getexclude() from the domain exclude list.

ipBlock.reason: Generated: ipset/def.sh _get_ipban() builds zapret-ip-user-ipban.txt from the hostname list zapret-hosts-user-ipban.txt, and the @ipban nft set is not referenced by any active rule. Writes would be inert and overwritten on the next manual ipban update.

autohostlist.reason: Engine-owned: nfqws2 itself maintains this file in autohostlist mode (the current MODE_FILTER=hostlist does not engage it). Never user-editable.
